title: ACCOUNT_MERGE fails with ACCOUNT_MERGE_DEST_FULL
pattern: A transaction whose ACCOUNT_MERGE operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (dest_full). The destination sells 429.4967297 NRV at 2147483647 XLM each: native buying liabilities of 2^63 - 2147483649 stroops, which leave it about 164 XLM of room below i64::MAX (TransactionUtils.cpp, addBalance). The 300 XLM merged in does not fit.

hazards.placement: merge into an account with no room below i64::MAX
an account balance plus buying liabilities near i64::MAX

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
